MandatorySites.title: Sites where autofill is always blocked
MandatorySites.description: Sites/domains on which form autocomplete/autofill is always suppressed. Users cannot remove these. Format: example.com (domain and subdomains), =host.example.com (exact host), https://example.com (scheme-restricted).

RecommendedSites.title: Sites where autofill is blocked by default
RecommendedSites.description: Sites/domains suppressed by default. Users can switch individual entries off in the extension options. Same format as MandatorySites.

AllowUserSites.title: Allow users to add their own sites
AllowUserSites.description: If false, users cannot add their own sites and any previously added user sites are ignored. Default: true.

AllowDisablingRecommended.title: Allow users to switch off recommended sites
AllowDisablingRecommended.description: If false, RecommendedSites behave like MandatorySites. Default: true.

BlockAutocomplete.title: Block single-field autocomplete history
BlockAutocomplete.description: Suppress saving and suggesting previously-typed values (single-field autocomplete) on listed sites by forcing autocomplete=off on forms and fields. When set by policy, users cannot change it. Default: true.

BlockAutofill.title: Block address / payment autofill
BlockAutofill.description: Suppress Autofill profile data (addresses, contact info, payment cards) on listed sites using the browser's per-site autofill setting where available, otherwise by temporarily disabling address and card autofill while a listed site is the active tab. When set by policy, users cannot change it. Default: true.

BlockPasswords.title: Block password manager
BlockPasswords.description: Also suppress the built-in password manager (saving and filling) on listed sites. When set by policy, users cannot change it. Default: false.

ShowBadge.title: Show toolbar badge on blocked sites
ShowBadge.description: Show an indicator on the toolbar icon when the current site is blocked. Default: true.
